text: User clarified wave semantics: the discovery/exploration wave is not plan completion. It must feed autonomous synthesis of the remaining execution/review/verification task graph, and the orchestrator continues until the plan goal is complete.

Added explicit wave-autonomy requirement: discovery/research is intermediate only; it must feed autonomous synthesis of the remaining execution/review/verification task graph until the plan GOAL is complete.

Plan state/doctor now separate planning-mode readiness from execution task coverage, include wave-autonomy guidance, and avoid treating pre-task planning as execution failure. Gates: cargo test cli plan_state 2/2, plan_doctor 9/9, plan_planning_gate_tests 3/3.
